pieces.name: front
pieces.notes: front N-S hip body 23 by 47 ft, ridge near x 475, S hips meet near (479,597); W face dark, E face lit; N end dies into the rear S face

pieces.name: rear_left
pieces.notes: rear W half, E-W ridge near y 428, hipped at the W end; N face about 8/12 (LiDAR 232 sq ft); S face continues the rear_right S face

pieces.name: rear_right
pieces.notes: rear E half, E-W ridge near y 425, hipped at the E end; N face about 7.5/12 (217 sq ft), big lit S face about 7/12 down to the patio line

pieces.name: north_cross
pieces.notes: narrow steep N-S cross on the N face, ridge near x 500, lit E face and dark W face about 16/12 per LiDAR (223 and 181 sq ft); gable end at the N eave where the trace shows a V notch; lowest confidence piece, could be a hip end instead

exclude_notes: rear brick patio with a small flat pool equipment cover, SE corner
W wall seen in the oblique image, trace overshoots the W eave by about 3 ft
notes: House tilted about 4 deg (u=[0.997,-0.077]). Rear is a 2-story E-W hip split into W and E halves (v1 rear_left only reached y 507 and fit 15%), plus a steep N cross gable that v1 missed; front N-S hip body is the 1-story part. Confidence medium-low: oblique imagery and the cross element.
